input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligations in Section 10
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 winds down access but gives us no exit help or data return, so we have added our preferred transition clause: up to six months of assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of any expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export if needed.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days after that expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion to Customer in writing.
